text:
PagerBot: ALERT: Dedicated pool node halo-ded-07 vGPU fault detected (ticket PD-98761). Severity: P1. Impacting tenant: Halo Enterprise (VPC: halo-prod).

Maya SRE: paging oncall @lin and eng-runtime @ben. seeing kernel dmesg loops: 
```
[ 1234.567890] nvidia 0000:3d:00.0: GPU reported ECC error, vGPU subchannel reset
[ 1234.568012] vfio-pci 0000:3d:00.0: failed to reset
[ 1234.569000] kworker/5:1: hang: reset timeout
```

Lin (infra-oncall): i'm on it. quick check: node still accepting connections but vGPUs are flapping, some containers restarted automatically. initiating immediate tenant isolation to stop churn. @raj please prep Halo CS comms.

Ben (eng-runtime): got logs from serving runtime. requests to halo-model-prod are queuing with long tail latencies ~1.2s -> 3s for small prompt paths. fallback policy is configured but some routes pinned to vGPU instance. flipping route to fallback model variant now.

ECS-deploy-bot: cordon halo-ded-07; draining tasks (expected 90s)

Maya SRE: timeline: 3101234567 alert -> 3101234578 isolation -> 3101234590 fallback route switch -> customers seeing degraded latencies but no 5xx so far.

Raj (cust-success): Halo Enterprise ops contact pinged. They report increased latency on their nightly scoring jobs. They asked if jobs will be requeued. telling them we're draining the node and moving workloads to fallback; will follow up with ETA.

Ben (eng-runtime): rolling restart of runtime on adjacent host triggered KV cache miss storm for halo-model-prod. doing controlled warm-up by replaying last 5k prefixes to warm KV cache to reduce regen cost. snippet of warm-up script: 
```
for key in latest_prefixes.txt; do curl -s -X POST $WARMUP_URL -d "{\"prefix\": \"$key\"}" &
done
```

Lin (infra-oncall): hardware telemetry shows power-cycling attempts and PCIe AER retransmits on GPU slot 3. raising hardware dispatch. @oleks can you confirm if we should hot-swap or evacuate and replace?

Oleks (hardware): remote BMC shows PSU voltage sag on node halo-ded-07, NIC flaps correlate. recommended: complete drain, power down for cold-reboot and run firmware reset on BMC/NIC/GPU. hot-swap not safe due to potential data-corrupt. ETA for replacement hardware crew: 2.5 hours if onsite; cold-reboot and QA might be faster remotely.

Maya SRE: decision: continue drain, finalize tenant isolation, keep fallback model route for Halo until node replaced. create maintenance window for halo-ded-07. @ben coordinate rollback plan if fallback degrades quality.

Raj (cust-success): sending interim message to Halo: "We've isolated the affected host and shifted production traffic to a verified fallback model; you may see latency increase for high-concurrency jobs. We're performing hardware investigation and will follow up with estimated time-to-replace. No data loss expected." :thumbsup:

Ben (eng-runtime): adding canary traffic for Halo to the fallback route so we can measure output quality delta. starting A/B at 5% -> 25% if metrics stable. instrumenting eval hooks to watch for regression.

InfraBot: Drain progress: 11 tasks remaining, 7/8 GPUs detached for tenants, 0 critical tasks interrupted.

Lin (infra-oncall): confirming live mitigation checklist:
- isolate node from routing (done)
- failover pinned routes to fallback (done)
- warm KV cache for model (in progress)
- notify customer (Raj done)
- hardware triage (Oleks dispatched)
- schedule replacement (pending)

Ben (eng-runtime): quality signals so far: rouge token rate +1.8%, respond-time p95 increased from 420ms -> 1.1s. A/B at 10% stable for 6m, no hallucination spike. holding.

Maya SRE: Pager duty note: @oncall please keep this P1 until hardware replaced or node healthy. logging incident in IR system PD-98761. adding timeline and mitigations.

Raj (cust-success): Halo replied: "Thanks — appreciate the fast mitigation. Please let us know when replacement is scheduled; our compliance team needs a postmortem." they requested a short RCA and customer impact window.

Lin (infra-oncall): running remote cold-reboot now (power cycle + BMC reset). output: 
```
power_control --host halo-ded-07 --action off && sleep 30 && power_control --host halo-ded-07 --action on
bmctool --host halo-ded-07 --reset
```

InfraBot: Node halo-ded-07 reachability: DOWN -> UP. BMC reports firmware version 3.4.2, GPU driver reloaded.

Oleks (hardware): post-reboot telemetry: PCIe errors persisted during boot, one GPU failed POST. filing hardware replacement. ordering GPU module + NIC (estimated delivery to data center 2.5h).

Ben (eng-runtime): switching off A/B to 25% until replacement; reverting pinned routes to fallback full-time for Halo to avoid churn. queueing nonurgent jobs.

Maya SRE: next steps/owners: 
- Lin: ensure tenant isolation remains and monitor until replacement.
- Ben: keep quality monitors and eval hooks; send final switch plan.
- Raj: prep customer-facing postmortem and timeline.
- Oleks: track hardware delivery/replace.

ECS-deploy-bot: drain complete. tasks migrated: 19 -> other nodes. expected residual connection teardown 30s.

Ben (eng-runtime): confirming no 5xx observed during migration window. continuing warmups.

Maya SRE: updating incident channel: PD-98761 mitigation in place; customer impacted (latency increase) but service preserved. will update when hardware replaced and node validated.

Raj (cust-success): Halo ops acknowledged. asking for incident link and ETA; sending now.

Oleks (hardware): replacement ETA updated: 2h 10m. proceeding to schedule hands-on replacement. will post serial console logs during swap.

InfraBot: Monitoring: p95 latency for halo-model-prod trending down from 1.1s -> 760ms after warmups. token cost spike noted; watch billing alerts.

Maya SRE: marking this thread as active mitigation. will close once hardware replaced and we move Halo back to pinned routes. please avoid making config changes to routing until confirm.

Ben (eng-runtime): once replacement done, plan: run full LV test -> reattach vGPU with safe vfio probe -> smoke test 10k inference calls -> ramp pinned traffic 0% -> 50% -> 100% over 30min if stable.

Raj (cust-success): postmortem asked: they want a short timeline + root cause + mitigation + customer impact. saving messages for PM.

Maya SRE: acknowledged. will compile after postmortem. thanks everyone. :heart:

Oleks (hardware): UPDATE 3101234620: replacement started. serial logs: 
```
[00:00] removing GPU module
[00:25] inserting replacement module
[00:30] POST OK
```

Maya SRE: great. once validated we'll reattach and follow Ben's ramp plan. closing updates here until validation.
